guarantee: The notes listing costs one followed stat per entry, with path resolution paid only for the notes root and for symlinks, and it still means what the path-based walk meant: the same response bytes (except the ruled read-without-search directory), nothing listed from outside the notes root even when a directory is swapped for a symlink mid-walk, no whole-listing failure from a looping or file-traversing symlink, and no state kept between requests.
title: Bounded notes listing with unchanged meaning
